messages:
Maria (AM): Heads up — CloudBank legal is asking for explicit POC acceptance criteria before signing. Can we align latency / cost / quality targets today? They want p99 latency at target load, a 1k-token cost ballpark, and a small prompt eval to validate quality.

Jon (Solutions): What load profile are they expecting? If we know qps and average seq len we can propose hosted vs dedicated. For 1k qps we should probably recommend a dedicated baseline + hosted fallback.

Kevin (Eng): Quick feasibility note — 1k qps sustained @ avg 256 tokens with p99 <= 250ms is tight. On Dedicated (4xA100-like config) + batching & KV cache we can get p99 in the 200–300ms window depending on cache hit rate. Need real prompt set to measure. We can propose a fallback to a cheaper model variant if cost target is firm.

Sara (Security): Security asks from their questionnaire: customer-managed KMS, VPC peering or Private plane, audit log export. For POC we can enable no-data-retention and KMS. Will need certs and an NDA if we go into Private.

Maria (AM): Action items: Jon — assemble 200–500 eval prompts covering their 3 priority flows (intent extraction, reranking, templated reply). Kevin — run a two-scenario bench on staging: 1) hosted-sim, 2) dedicated-baseline. Return p50/p95/p99 + token cost. Sara — draft security Q answers for Q3–Q7. Deadline: get a draft SOW to me by EOD tomorrow.

Jon (Solutions): I'll curate prompt buckets. Plan: 100 intents, 100 rerank pairs, 100 generative prompts across short/long. Example snippet I'll use in harness: 
```
prompt: "Customer message: 'I can't access my billing'"
expected_intent: "billing_help"
```
I'll push a PR to the eval repo with labels and baselines.

Kevin (Eng): I'll kick off perf runs tonight. I'll include runs for 0% cache and 30% prefix cache (their session reuse unknown). Also will test quantized profile q4f16 to show cost/quality tradeoff. Expect to upload perf table + raw logs by 10:30 UTC.

Maria (AM): Pricing ask from CloudBank: target cost <= $0.80 / 1k tokens for POC. Finance/billing — realistic?

billing-bot: Rough estimate: hosted (managed) at current model weights ~ $1.10 / 1k tokens. Dedicated amortized could get to $0.45–0.70 / 1k depending on commit and utilization. For a short 8–12 week trial the effective rate will depend heavily on utilization.

Kevin (Eng): If cost is non-negotiable, recommend an 8-week Dedicated trial with a 1% canary ramp for safety. Also propose autoscale floor and a quantization profile (q4f16) to meet cost while keeping quality. Will include a fallback model mapping policy for graceful degradation.

Maria (AM): On quality thresholds they asked for: ">=85% intent accuracy" and "NDCG@10 >= 0.7" for rerank. Are those measurable with our harness?

Jon (Solutions): Yes — intent accuracy and NDCG are straightforward. For generative outputs we should pair automated metrics with a small human review (10–20 samples) or use a pretrained classifier as a proxy. Suggest gate: intent >= 82% to pass.

Sara (Security): I'll prepare the questionnaire answers: data at rest encryption, audit logs to their SIEM, no model fine-tuning on customer data during POC, and rotation policy for keys. Will attach standard SOC2 snippet.

Maria (AM): Perfect. I'll synthesize into the SOW draft. Can everyone confirm by 16:00 so I can send to Legal? :thumbsup:

Jon (Solutions): Confirmed.

Kevin (Eng): Confirmed — will upload perf artifacts and run notes.

Sara (Security): Confirmed — will add the security appendix.

Maria (AM): Thanks team — once legal signs NDA I'll ping the CloudBank contact and send the SOW.

(automated): deploy-bot: reminder — please attach perf logs to the secure S3 bucket and tag with project/cloudbank-poc."
